rubric.statement: The example patches `litellm.responses` itself and captures the outbound kwargs from a `dspy.LM(..., model_type='responses')` call, so the inspected payload is the final post-conversion request DSPy sends.
The patched function returns a response-like object/mock result so the program runs end-to-end without making a real provider request.
The LM invocation passes a `pydantic.BaseModel` subclass as the `response_format` argument while using the responses backend.
The captured outbound payload is asserted to omit any top-level `response_format` field.

The captured outbound payload is asserted to place the schema under `text['format']`, with JSON-schema metadata derived from the Pydantic model: the model name, `type == 'json_schema'`, and schema content/properties matching `model_json_schema()`.
